title: Endpoint QuickCreate — wireframe variants, microcopy candidates, and grooming notes
content:
Context and goal:
We need a compact "QuickCreate" flow for users who want to spin up a model endpoint in under 60 seconds. Target personas: product engineers, rapid-prototypers, and solutions engineers demoing to customers. This doc collects alternative wireframes, copy variants for microcopy/tooltips, and a prioritized grooming checklist for the backlog.

Design constraints and assumptions:
- We must reuse catalog metadata (model family, size, recommended latency bucket) and expose only the most common knobs by default.
- Advanced tuning should be progressive disclosure (collapsed panel / modal).
- Pinning: users can pin to a specific model version or choose floating (latest-compatible). Include clear warnings about risk and rollback ergonomics.
- QuickCreate must integrate with Dedicated/Private availability detection and show fallback options if region/capacity unavailable.

Wireframe variants (high-level descriptions):
1) Compact Stepper (default)
- Screen 1: "Pick a model" — search bar + top 5 recommended tiles (small image, name, latency badge). Each tile has a small chevron for expand. Primary action: "Select". Secondary: "View details".
- Screen 2: "Create endpoint" — form with three required fields: endpoint name, inference mode (text/chat/embedding), traffic config (single instance/auto-scale suggestion). Beneath, short line: "Defaults chosen to balance cost and latency for this model."
- Screen 3: Success toast + link to endpoint page.
Notes: minimal friction. Use default pins = "floating latest compatible" so users get updates; callout link "Pin a version".

2) Guided QuickCreate (wizard with inline help)
- Inline help on each form field with expandable examples.
- Pinning presented as a radio group: "Always use latest compatible" vs "Pin to specific version" (when choose second, show dropdown with last 5 versions).
- Before final create, show a compact estimate card: "Estimated cost / 1k tokens" + latency expectation.
Notes: better for novice users; slightly longer.

3) Minimal Single-screen (for CLI parity)
- Single screen with 4 inline fields and a prominent "Create" button. Hover tooltips only.
- Pin option hidden behind a small link "More options".
Notes: fastest, but hides pinning and routing controls — risk of surprising updates.

Copy and microcopy experiments (each candidate phrased for A/B testing):
- Endpoint name placeholder candidates:
  A: "e.g., chat-support-prod"
  B: "Friendly name for this endpoint (no spaces)"
  C: "MyEndpoint — visible in logs and billing"
- Pinning radio group copy:
  - Option 1 label: "Use latest compatible version (recommended)"
    helper: "Keeps you on current model family updates; no manual rollouts."
  - Option 2 label: "Pin to a specific version"
    helper: "Pinning prevents upgrades; configure rollouts from the endpoint page."
- Cost estimate card microcopy:
  - Title candidates: "Estimated unit cost", "Approx cost per 1k tokens", "Predicted token spend"
  - Body candidate: "This is based on observed med. seq length of our workloads. Actual cost may vary."
- Failure/fallback copy when capacity is low:
  - Primary: "Limited capacity in chosen region. We'll fallback to a compatible variant with similar latency. Review fallback choices on the endpoint page."
  - Alternative (short): "Capacity low — creating endpoint on alternative hardware."

Tooltips and help strings (short, concrete):
- "Latency badge": "90th percentile latency on this model in region us-west."
- "Floating latest": "Automatically use newer vetted model versions without changing the endpoint name."
- "Pin consequences": "Pinned endpoints won't automatically receive model updates — remember to roll forward when you validate new versions."

UI components and behavior notes:
- Version picker dropdown should show version id, release date, and a simple tag (stable/beta), and expose a small diff link to open model release notes.
- If user pins a version that is unavailable in selected deployment type (e.g., quantized-only), show inline validation and suggested compatible alternatives.
- Confirmatory inline banner post-create: "Endpoint created with pin: v1.2.3 — to switch to latest, click 'Update pinned version' on endpoint settings."

Accessibility and copy length limits:
- Limit helper lines to 140 chars. Buttons should not exceed 22 chars. Ensure keyboard-first flow for selections. Screen reader labels for pin radio group must include version id when pinned.

Backlog grooming (prioritized):
- High (P0):
  * PROD-1987: Implement QuickCreate stepper skeleton + catalog tiles (2 sprints).
  * UX-423: Version picker component with diff link and availability validation (1 sprint).
- Medium (P1):
  * Add cost estimate card with live pricing lookup (depends on billing service) (1 sprint).
  * Copy A/B testing instrumentation for endpoint name and pinning wording (0.5 sprint).
- Low (P2):
  * Guided QuickCreate help overlays (nice-to-have).

Open questions / design decisions to resolve:
- Which default should we pick for first-time users — floating latest or pinned? My recommendation: floating latest with a clearly visible 'Pin' link and a short one-time modal explaining the difference. Rationale: reduces regressions from surprise updates while enabling Ops teams to pin if they need strict control.
- How do we reconcile Dedicated/Private deployments when pinned version isn't available? Proposal: allow creation with a compatibility check and schedule an alert to SRE to onboard the version or offer a quantized fallback with a visible quality warning.
- Telemetry: Which events do we need? Suggested minimal set: quickcreate_started, model_selected, pin_selected (value), create_submitted, create_succeeded/create_failed, fallback_used.

Design samples (screen-by-screen quick copy):
- Pick a model (title)
  - Subtitle: "Search the model catalog or choose a recommended model for fast setup."
  - Tile badge: "~35ms (us-west)"
- Create endpoint (title)
  - Endpoint name field label: "Endpoint name"
  - Endpoint name helper (short): "Lowercase, hyphens OK, max 32 chars."
  - Inference mode label: "Mode" helper: "Text / Chat / Embeddings — choose based on your input format."
  - Pin group (title): "Version stability" helper: "Choose whether this endpoint should auto-track model updates."
  - CTA: "Create endpoint" (primary), secondary: "Advanced options"

Edge cases to test in QA:
- Creating endpoint while the model is in the middle of a release (version listed but with status 'rolling'). Ensure pin dropdown disables rolling versions and shows a tooltip.
- Create with name collision — surface existing endpoint link and quick actions: "Open" / "Create with different name".
- Mobile/tablet layout for quickcreate — stack tiles vertically, collapse estimate card by default.

Implementation notes for engineers (dev handoff):
- API contract needed: POST /endpoints should accept body {name, model_id, pinned_version?, mode, min_instances?, autoscale_policy?} — return estimated_cost and deployment_plan when preview=true.
- UI should call a preview endpoint to populate the estimate card and availability hints before submit. Add debounce for model search.
- Add feature flag: quickcreate_v2 to toggle flows for canary customers.

Next steps (short timeline):
- Feb 21: Design sync to finalize microcopy and choose A/B variants (owners: Maya + Priya).
- Feb 28: Engineering spike for version picker + preview API (owners: Ethan + Luca).
- Mar 7: Cut first QA build behind feature flag.

Notes to reviewers:
- Please comment inline on which microcopy variant feels clearer for Ops vs product engineers.
- If you think default pinning should be the opposite, leave a short rationale and customer example.

Historic references and inspiration:
- Borrowing small patterns from our console onboarding modal and the model-rollouts UX — see Confluence:catalog-guidelines-8742 for previous heuristics.
- Implementation parallels: AWS SageMaker quickstart flows and Vercel's "Deploy" quick-creation experience.

End of doc.
